message: I figured you might be, Daisy. Unfortunately, I only got the brief info from Kieran's presentation, and he's a much better person to ask. Still, the idea of designing social software for explicitly political purposes is fascinating; in some ways, the relation between the political agenda and the technological agenda seems to be inverse of what[Collin and Jeff](http://wrt-brooke.syr.edu/cgbvb/archives/2005/04/booles_rush_in.html) were talking about a while back, at least in its sequence. Perhaps the lesson to be taken is that neither can precede the other.
